scope: Initial, manually curated research for a Jordanian pizza and kebab concept considering Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Coverage counts describe available observations, not a completed market study.
methodology: Search results were used to discover leads; records were written from inspected source pages or linked official PDFs. Factual observations are paraphrases, not recommendations.
Undated pages retain published_on=null. checked_on is the UTC calendar date of inspection, not publication. Copyright years and site-wide update dates are not treated as publication dates.
Both-city tags on UAE menus, merchant services, and distribution claims indicate shared applicability; they do not establish identical customer behavior or site-specific availability.
Prices preserve menu item, displayed portion, branch or national menu, and ordering channel. No completed checkout was made and tax treatment, extras, and delivery fees were not verified.

Dynamic delivery menus can change within an inspection. An Al Najda menu exposed different subsets, so the Abu Dhabi sandwich records use the inspected Khalifa City menu. Availability must be checked again.
Only metadata and catalogue category descriptions were inspected for Bidfood products; individual product specifications and supplier quotes were not verified.
Records with old publication dates deliberately retain needs_review flags. A newly checked historical source is not a current market measurement.
This file documents research coverage and gaps; runtime retrieval reads market_evidence.json only.

dubai.observed_basis: Heritage/souk setting and listed pizza branches in Al Muraqqabat and Port Saeed; these are different parts of the district.
Listed pizza and Lebanese street-food restaurants in mall and Hessa Street settings; the latter advertises late delivery.
Listed pizza branch near a metro station and a restaurant at a residential hotel with extended advertised hours. JBR records are nearby comparisons, not the same catchment.

abu_dhabi.observed_basis: Tourism guide describes restaurants, parks, and nearby landmarks; a pizza branch is listed at Abu Dhabi Mall.
Mall dining and leisure facilities near the Corniche, plus a listed pizza branch in Al Khalidiyah; district boundaries and exact units need site review.
Retail, hypermarket, and dining anchor; branch directory places Al Wahda Mall in Al Manhal.

candidate_area_limit: Investigation shortlist only. No area has a verified vacant unit, rent, customer profile, footfall, delivery catchment, or expected order count. Mall observations do not describe all surrounding streets.

dubai.category: Lebanese street food, shawarma, grills, sandwiches, and pizza
Restaurant with extended hours; detailed menu not curated

abu_dhabi.category: Lebanese shawarma, grilled sandwiches, and manakish

abu_dhabi.limit: Khalifa branch platform heading only; airport concession has restricted airside access and is not a street-site pricing benchmark.

price_comparison_limits: Sized national Papa Johns pizzas can support comparison by diameter. Allo Beirut pizza diameters are unspecified; its prices are not size-equivalent.
Shawarma, grilled tawouk sandwiches, falafel, manakish, and meal bundles are distinct products. Their prices must not be combined into one like-for-like average.
Dubai JBR and Abu Dhabi Khalifa City are specific branches on Deliveroo; their prices do not establish city averages or dine-in prices.
Several prices come from the same brands. They establish observed examples, not the distribution of independent neighborhood competitor prices.
